stories.title: Labour’s Laura Murton wins Mold Broncoed by-election
stories.summary: Labour’s Laura Murton has won the Mold Broncoed by-election, keeping the Flintshire County Council seat for her party. She received 250 votes, ahead of Reform UK Wales candidate Richard Clarke on 197. Welsh Liberal Democrat Nanette Davies came third with 139 votes. stories.title: Four Flintshire council motions shut out by new three-motion limit
stories.summary: Four motions from Flintshire councillors will not be debated at next week’s full council meeting, because of a limit on motions brought in this year. stories.title: Flintshire roads need £5.2m a year to stop getting worse, but council plans £2m
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council says it needs £5.2m a year to stop the county’s roads getting worse, but its spending plan for the next three years sets aside £2m a year. stories.title: Shotton care home rated good in every area by inspectors
stories.summary: Hollybank Care Home on Shotton Lane was rated good for well-being, care, environment and leadership, with no areas for improvement found.

stories.title: Nine Flintshire postcodes hit by Thursday night power cut
stories.summary: Part of Gwespyr is without power this evening after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 11.20pm.
